_about: Public-domain James Foster (1697-1753), Baptist preacher at the Old Jewry, for the Word Hoard: his Sermons (London 1733, four volumes), The Usefulness, Truth and Excellency of the Christian Revelation (1734) and Discourses on all the principal branches of Natural Religion and Social Virtue (1749, two volumes), from Internet Archive scans. Added 2026-10-23 by lane A, round 46 (my pick); Adam may veto the whole shelf. Every printing dated before 1930, so public domain in the US. No uids minted.
